material.acceptance_criteria: After a minimap press on a blocked edge cell, a camera move, or setCamera, cam.target is inside cam.bounds. A property test over random press and move targets on a map with blocked edges asserts it.
material.description: PBTAGENT property: after every camera write, cam.target lies inside cam.bounds (the walkable box). Pan keeps it: panCamera ends in clampTarget (js/client/render3d.js:211-217; clampTarget 201-205). Three writes do not: setCamera sets target with no clamp (render3d.js:547-555); the camera move builds its target from ev.x/ev.y unclamped (js/client/modui.js:152-157) and writes it through setCamera (modui.js:166-176). The minimap maps any press across the full map extent (js/client/ui_minimap.js:175-182, centre(fx*mapSize.w, fz*mapSize.h)), sent as camera_to (js/client/hud.js:71; scenarios/moba/controls.lua:561 passes fx(args.x) through unclamped; the sim-side game.camera clamp is not verified in this lane). cameraBounds is the walkable extent (js/client/play.js:478-479, from walkableBounds at js/client/tiles.js:109-121), smaller than the map whenever edge cells are blocked or cliff. Symptom: a press on the minimap's blocked border leaves the view centred outside the walkable box, and the next drag snaps the target back (render3d.js:217). Witness: fs_read dispatches 1792859120895-6134-cc2f7e9573f9e487 (modui.js 150-158), 1792859124044-6136-9bf589406449a7dc (play.js 470-483), 1792859130215-6145-aae895c3e6f866d7 (tiles.js 105-125), 1792858779532-5837-15898496847076db (render3d.js 540-560, setCamera), 1792858675059-5723-87361a00d6f186f4 (ui_minimap.js whole file).

notes.note: Triage keep. Located: setCamera render3d.js:547-553 writes target with no clampTarget; modui.js:156-157 builds the camera-event target from ev.x/ev.y unclamped and step (modui.js:174-177) writes it through setCamera. panCamera clamps via clampTarget (render3d.js:201-205, :210-218) against cam.bounds, which play.js:2741 sets to cameraBounds (play.js:479; walkableBounds tiles.js:109-121 excludes blocked and cliff cells). Observable: a minimap press or camera move can leave the target outside the walkable box, and the next drag snaps it back. Reads: render3d.js 201-225 dispatch 1792777868-placeholder
Correction to the note above: its render3d read dispatch id is 1792859777868-6587-f676538b74eec446 (render3d.js 201-225, session verify-MUTATION-trav-minimap-camera-1); the id typed there was wrong.

drain-gui-minimap-1: blocked, partly outside this lane. Writes without clamp: setCamera render3d.js:547-553 (render3d.js forbidden) and the camera move modui.js:152-177 (not owned by this lane). The minimap press path ui_minimap.js centreAt has no walkable bounds to clamp to. Clearing action: owner of render3d.js and modui.js routes every camera write through clampTarget against cam.bounds; then witness a blocked-edge press.

Code already on origin: setCamera returns clampTarget (render3d.js ~556). Live blocked-edge press probe not run. Live witness blocked: gm browser verb claims the dispatch and never writes its out-file (5 tries, gm-mcp 0.2.302 and 0.2.305, bodies with and without gm_session_id, about:blank included); each holds the state lane until the 600 s watchdog. Clearing action: fix the browser executor in the agentplug runner.
